# Generated by ppc build from [stored_food] in constructor.toml (stored_food.py); do not edit by hand.

# Province scope. Keeps the province on the Stored Food step of its store: the stored months rounded to the nearest
# whole month (half a month rounds up), re-picked only when the store moved more than half a month + 0.05
# away from the carried step, so a store sitting on a boundary does not flip back and forth. The consumption (a loop
# over the province's locations) is worked out once. A province nobody eats in carries no step.
# pp_stored_food_months keeps the stored months themselves (re-set when they moved by more than 0.05) for
# the AI weights and displays that read pp_location_stored_months; pp_food_store_step keeps the carried step.
# Variables and locals carry + 100 (a variable at 0 counts as unset); `var:x = n` compares scopes, so only < / >
# ranges are used. A province never refreshed starts at 50, below every store, so its first refresh applies;
# 99 marks a province without a step.
pp_refresh_stored_food = {
	# old saves: drop the whole-month tier modifier and its variables once
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_1 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_2 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_3 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_4 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_4 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_5 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_5 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_6 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_6 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_7 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_7 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_8 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_8 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_9 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_9 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_10 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_10 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_11 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_11 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_12 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_12 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_13 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_13 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_14 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_14 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_15 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_15 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_16 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_16 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_17 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_17 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_18 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_18 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_19 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_19 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_20 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_20 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_21 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_21 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_22 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_22 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_23 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_23 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_24 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_24 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_tier }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_next } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_next }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_change } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_change }
	}
	# old saves: the scaled modifiers (2026-10-01..03) and the single-modifier version's months
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_low_stores } remove_province_modifier = pp_low_stores }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_full_stores } remove_province_modifier = pp_full_stores }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_size } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_size }
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_consumption value = { value = pp_stored_food_province_consumption add = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_target value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption > 100 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = pp_stored_food_target
			value = {
				value = province_food
				divide = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption subtract = 100 }
				min = 0
				max = { value = define:NEconomy|GROWTH_FROM_FOOD_MULTIPLIER_MAX multiply = 12 }
				add = 100
			}
		}
	}
	# the stored months (AI weights, displays)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_months } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_months value = 50 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_change value = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target subtract = var:pp_stored_food_months add = 100 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				local_var:pp_stored_food_change > 100.05
				local_var:pp_stored_food_change < 99.95
				AND = { local_var:pp_stored_food_target < 100.00001 var:pp_stored_food_months > 100.00001 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_months value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target }
	}
	# the Stored Food step
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_food_store_step } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_food_store_step value = 50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption > 100 }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_food_store_change value = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target subtract = var:pp_food_store_step add = 100 } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { local_var:pp_food_store_change > 100.55 local_var:pp_food_store_change < 99.45 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_food_store_new value = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target add = 0.5 floor = yes max = 124 } }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_0 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_0 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_1 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_1 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_2 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_2 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_3 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_3 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_4 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_4 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_5 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_5 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_6 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_6 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_7 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_7 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_8 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_8 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_9 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_9 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_10 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_10 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_11 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_11 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_12 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_12 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_13 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_13 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_14 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_14 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_15 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_15 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_16 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_16 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_17 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_17 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_18 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_18 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_19 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_19 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_20 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_20 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_21 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_21 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_22 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_22 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_23 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_23 }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_24 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_24 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 100.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_0 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 101.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 102.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_2 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 103.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_3 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 104.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_4 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 105.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_5 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 106.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_6 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 107.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_7 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 108.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_8 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 109.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_9 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 110.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_10 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 111.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_11 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 112.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_12 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 113.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_13 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 114.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_14 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 115.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_15 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 116.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_16 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 117.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_17 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 118.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_18 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 119.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_19 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 120.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_20 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 121.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_21 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 122.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_22 } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:pp_food_store_new < 123.5 } add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_23 } }
			else = { add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_food_store_24 } }
			set_variable = { name = pp_food_store_step value = local_var:pp_food_store_new }
		}
	}
	# nobody eats here: no step
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:pp_food_store_step > 99.5 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_0 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_0 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_1 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_2 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_3 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_4 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_4 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_5 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_5 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_6 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_6 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_7 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_7 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_8 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_8 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_9 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_9 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_10 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_10 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_11 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_11 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_12 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_12 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_13 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_13 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_14 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_14 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_15 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_15 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_16 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_16 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_17 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_17 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_18 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_18 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_19 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_19 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_20 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_20 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_21 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_21 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_22 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_22 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_23 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_23 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_food_store_24 } remove_province_modifier = pp_food_store_24 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_food_store_step value = 99 }
	}
	# Farm Produce: once a year (January) and at the province's first refresh
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { current_month < 2 NOT = { has_variable = pp_farm_produce_set } } }
		pp_refresh_farm_produce = yes
	}
}

# Province scope. Farm Produce: every location of the province that holds one of the kitchens gets the modifier
# at size = the province's worked farm and orchard levels (pp_province_farm_levels) / 40.0, at most 1;
# every other location loses it. Run by the store refresh, so it adds no pulse of its own.
pp_refresh_farm_produce = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_farm_produce_size value = { value = pp_province_farm_levels divide = 40.0 max = 1 } }
	every_location_in_province = {
		if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_farm_produce } remove_location_modifier = pp_farm_produce }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_farm_produce_size > 0.01 OR = { has_building = building_type:cookshop has_building = building_type:public_kitchen } }
			add_location_modifier = { modifier = pp_farm_produce size = scope:pp_farm_produce_size }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = pp_farm_produce_set value = 1 }
}
